title: AuthFailed error message says 'authentication failed' for HTTP 403 (authorization, not authentication)
description: check_auth_status maps both 401 (authentication failed: credentials missing/invalid) and 403 (authorization failed: credentials present but insufficient) to ClientError::AuthFailed with message 'authentication failed: HTTP 403'. A 403 is an authorization failure, not an authentication failure. A user seeing 'authentication failed: HTTP 403' at 2am will change their password rather than check their account permissions. Suggested fix: rename to AuthOrAuthzFailed, or split into AuthFailed(401) and Forbidden(403), or change the error message to 'HTTP error {code}: unauthorized or forbidden'.
